title: Dimensional weight
description: Dimensional (volumetric) billed weight for a PARCEL — a DERIVED value the checkout computes, not filled by the seller: billed = max(actual gross mass, volumetric weight), where volumetric = packaged volume ÷ a divisor, with each packaged dimension rounded up before multiplying, and the divisor read from the seller's shipping profile. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when a parcel is billed by dimensional weight. Carries the computed billed weight plus the divisor applied. The checkout computes the weight from the order's catalog items: their gross mass, summed over the order's lines, and their packaged dimensions, read for a one-unit order. PARCELS ONLY — transporting people (ride-hailing) is a different, per-mile future clause; dimensional weight is not its concern.

fields.name: billedMassGrams
fields.description: The billed dimensional weight in whole grams — max(actual gross mass, volumetric weight), the greater of the physical and volumetric mass, per carrier practice.

fields.name: divisor
fields.description: The divisor in mm³ per gram (the carrier's cm³ per kg, the same number): volumetric weight in whole grams is each packaged dimension rounded up to the next whole centimeter, multiplied in mm³, divided by this divisor and rounded up, and the billed weight is the larger of that and the gross mass. Mass and dimensions come from the catalog items and are committed only when a clause declaring them is composed beside this one.
